transportSystems.name: Djerba yellow taxis
transportSystems.summary: Metered or negotiated island taxis. Prefer official ranks.
transportSystems.howItWorks: Wave or go to a rank. Confirm destination and fare before departure if meter is off.
warnings: Agree fare at night and from airport

transportSystems.name: Louage (shared taxi)
transportSystems.summary: Shared vans/cars on fixed corridors — cheap and local.
transportSystems.howItWorks: Go to louage station, say destination, wait for seats to fill, pay per seat.
warnings: Depart when full — wait times vary

transportSystems.name: SNTRI / local buses
transportSystems.summary: Intercity and island bus links — slower but cheap.
transportSystems.howItWorks: Check station boards; buy ticket or pay on board depending on line.

transportSystems.name: Ajim–Jorf ferry
transportSystems.summary: Car/passenger ferry connecting Djerba to mainland near Ajim.
transportSystems.howItWorks: Queue at Ajim or Jorf terminal; frequent daytime crossings.

transportSystems.name: Bike rental (tourist zones)
transportSystems.summary: Day rentals near hotels and Midoun.
transportSystems.howItWorks: Passport deposit often required; check brakes and lights.
warnings: Roads can be uneven; wear a helmet if provided

transportSystems.name: Scooter rental
transportSystems.howItWorks: International license sometimes requested; inspect scooter before leaving.
warnings: Night riding without lights is risky

transportSystems.name: Car rental agencies
transportSystems.summary: Airport and town agencies for full-island mobility.
transportSystems.howItWorks: Book ahead in peak season; check insurance excess.
warnings: Fuel stations sparse in some south villages

transportSystems.name: Hotel / airport transfers
transportSystems.summary: Pre-booked transfers from DJE airport to hotels.
transportSystems.howItWorks: Arrange via hotel; driver meets with name sign in arrivals.
warnings: Confirm pickup time for late flights

transportSystems.name: Walking (town centres)
transportSystems.summary: Fine inside Houmt Souk medina and Midoun centre for short hops.
transportSystems.howItWorks: Use sidewalks where available; midday heat is intense.

transportSystems.name: Private car / own vehicle
transportSystems.summary: If you already have a car/scooter on the island.
transportSystems.howItWorks: Park carefully in medina; watch one-way streets.
